docs.text: Helper CLI This page provides documentation for our command line tools. helper Usage: helper [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]... Options: Name Type Description Default -V , --version boolean Show the version and exit. False -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False Subcommands all : Show all info arch : Display system architecture information. docker : Docker container and image management. env : Manage environment variables. file : File management and processing commands. internal-ip : Display the local/internal IP address. nixos : NixOS related commands. public-ip : Display the public (external) IP address. run : Run predefined command snippets. speed : Test internet speed using speedtest.net system-info : Display system information including CPU, RAM, and disk usage venv : Manage Python virtual environments. helper all Show all info Usage: helper all [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper arch Display system architecture information. Shows the machine hardware name, which is useful for determining if you're running on x86_64, arm64, or other architectures. Equivalent to running 'uname -m' in the terminal. Example: $ h arch arm64 Usage: helper arch [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper docker Docker container and image management. Manage Docker containers and images with subcommands for common operations. Subcommands: ps List containers run Run a command in a new container rm Remove one or more containers rmi Remove one or more images url Show containers with their HTTP/HTTPS URLs Examples: h d ps # List running containers h d run nginx # Run an nginx container h d rm container # Remove a container Usage: helper docker [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]... Options: Name Type Description Default -v , --verbose integer range ( 0 and above) Increase verbosity (can be used multiple times) 0 -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False Subcommands ps : List containers. rm : Remove one or more containers. rmi : Remove one or more images. run : Run a command in a new container. url : Show containers with their HTTP/HTTPS URLs. helper docker ps List containers. Usage: helper docker ps [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default --all , -a boolean Show all containers (default shows just running) False --all-containers boolean Show all containers (default shows just running) False --format , -f choice ( table | json ) Output format table --help , -h boolean Show this message and exit. False helper docker rm Remove one or more containers. Usage: helper docker rm [OPTIONS] [CONTAINERS]... Options: Name Type Description Default --force , -f boolean Force the removal of a running container (uses SIGKILL) False --volumes , -v boolean Remove anonymous volumes associated with the container False -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper docker rmi Remove one or more images. Usage: helper docker rmi [OPTIONS] [IMAGE] Options: Name Type Description Default --all-tags , -a boolean Remove all versions of the image with the given name False --force , -f boolean Force removal of the image False --no-prune boolean Do not delete untagged parents False -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper docker run Run a command in a new container. Usage: helper docker run [OPTIONS] [IMAGE] Options: Name Type Description Default --name text Assign a name to the container Sentinel.UNSET --port , -p text Publish a container's port(s) to the host Sentinel.UNSET --detach , -d boolean Run container in background and print container ID False --env , -e text Set environment variables Sentinel.UNSET --volume , -v text Bind mount a volume Sentinel.UNSET -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper docker url Show containers with their HTTP/HTTPS URLs. Usage: helper docker url [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default --show-all , -a boolean Show all containers (default shows just running) False --http-only , -h boolean Show only containers with HTTP/HTTPS ports False --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper env Manage environment variables. Usage: helper env [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]... Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False Subcommands get : Get environment variable(s). list : List all environment variables in a formatted table. set : Set an environment variable. source : Export all environment variables to current shell session. unset : Unset an environment variable. helper env get Get environment variable(s). If no key is provided, all environment variables will be shown as a table. Usage: helper env get [OPTIONS] [KEY] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper env list List all environment variables in a formatted table. Usage: helper env list [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper env set Set an environment variable. Usage: helper env set [OPTIONS] KEY VALUE Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper env source Export all environment variables to current shell session. Example: eval $(h env source) source <(h env source) Usage: helper env source [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper env unset Unset an environment variable. Usage: helper env unset [OPTIONS] KEY Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper file File management and processing commands. Usage: helper file [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]... Options: Name Type Description Default --directory , -d directory Directory to search in (default: current directory) . --extension , -e text Filter by file extension (without dot) Sentinel.UNSET --size , -s boolean Show file sizes False --modified , -m boolean Show last modified time False -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False Subcommands newest : Show the newest files in the directory. oldest : Show the oldest files in the directory. helper file newest Show the newest files in the directory. Usage: helper file newest [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default --count , -n integer Number of newest files to show (default: 1) 1 -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper file oldest Show the oldest files in the directory. Usage: helper file oldest [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default --count , -n integer Number of oldest files to show (default: 1) 1 -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper internal-ip Display the local/internal IP address. This command shows the internal (LAN) IP address of your machine. It automatically detects the correct network interface based on your OS. Examples: $ h ip 192.168.1.100 Note: On multi-homed systems, this shows the primary network interface's IP. Usage: helper internal-ip [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper nixos NixOS related commands. Usage: helper nixos [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]... Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False Subcommands clean : Clean Nix store and perform garbage collection. search : Search for Nix packages. version : Show NixOS version. helper nixos clean Clean Nix store and perform garbage collection. Usage: helper nixos clean [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default -f , --force boolean Force garbage collection and remove all old generations False -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper nixos search Search for Nix packages. Usage: helper nixos search [OPTIONS] [PACKAGE] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper nixos version Show NixOS version. Usage: helper nixos version [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper public-ip Display the public (external) IP address. This command retrieves and displays your public IP address as seen from the internet. It's useful for checking your current external network identity. Examples: $ h pubip 203.0.113.45 Note: Requires an active internet connection. Uses ifconfig.me service by default. Usage: helper public-ip [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper run Run predefined command snippets. Usage: helper run [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]... Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False Subcommands add : Add or update a snippet. edit : Edit snippets file directly in your default editor. exec : Execute a snippet with the given arguments. list : List all available snippets. remove : Remove a snippet by name. show : Show the command template for a specific snippet by name or index. helper run add Add or update a snippet. Example: h run add click-odoo "docker exec {ODOO_CONTAINER} bash -c "click-odoo {file}"" Note: {container} will be automatically converted to {ODOO_CONTAINER} and {db_container} to {ODOO_DB_CONTAINER} Usage: helper run add [OPTIONS] NAME [COMMAND]... Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper run edit Edit snippets file directly in your default editor. Usage: helper run edit [OPTIONS] [EDITOR] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper run exec Execute a snippet with the given arguments. Examples: h run exec click-odoo /path/to/script.py h run exec 1 /path/to/script.py h run exec --force 1 /path/to/script.py Usage: helper run exec [OPTIONS] SNIPPET [ARGS]... Options: Name Type Description Default -f , --force boolean Skip confirmation prompt False -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper run list List all available snippets. Usage: helper run list [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper run remove Remove a snippet by name. Usage: helper run remove [OPTIONS] NAME Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper run show Show the command template for a specific snippet by name or index. Examples: h run show 1 h run show click-odoo Usage: helper run show [OPTIONS] SNIPPET Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper speed Test internet speed using speedtest.net This command tests your internet connection's download and upload speeds using the speedtest.net service through the Python speedtest-cli library. Usage: helper speed [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default --simple , -s boolean Only show basic speed information False -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper system-info Display system information including CPU, RAM, and disk usage Usage: helper system-info [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper venv Manage Python virtual environments. Usage: helper venv [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]... Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False Subcommands deactivate : Deactivate the current virtual environment. source : Source a Python virtual environment. helper venv deactivate Deactivate the current virtual environment. Usage: h venv deactivate # Show the deactivate command eval $(h venv deactivate) # In bash/zsh to deactivate the virtual environment Usage: helper venv deactivate [OPTIONS] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False helper venv source Source a Python virtual environment. If no path is provided, searches for a virtual environment in the current or parent directories. Looks for 'venv' first, then '.venv'. Usage: h venv source [PATH] # Source the specified virtual environment or auto-detect eval $(h venv source) # In bash/zsh to activate the virtual environment source <(h venv source) # Alternative syntax for bash/zsh Usage: helper venv source [OPTIONS] [PATH] Options: Name Type Description Default -h , --help boolean Show this message and exit. False
